content.short: K3 Capital is an on-chain asset and risk manager curating DeFi lending vaults.
content.description: K3 Capital acts as a risk curator, setting the parameters and collateral policy for lending vaults that depositors allocate into, and carrying responsibility for how those positions behave under stress. The curator model emerged with isolated lending markets such as Morpho and Euler, which separated the protocol's mechanics from the judgement calls about what to lend against. It operates vaults on both Hyperliquid and Monad.
